evidence.excerpt: Our framework extracts each conversational turn into typed nodes and attributed edges, answers questions from a two-hop subgraph, and periodically prunes nodes that score low on a weighted combination of recency, access frequency, degree centrality, and age.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: On LongMemEval, the graph does not outperform a flat vector baseline at a matched candidate-generation budget of five retrieval roots: token F1 is $0.417$ against $0.468$, and a paired bootstrap over 500 questions gives $Δ= -0.050$ (95\% CI $[-0.085, -0.016]$).
